title: Simulating colonic tissue mechanics using a structure-based material model in Abaqus
author: Bhavesh Patel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wzeff3e
materials: Go to the MATERIALS section of the file. You shoud see the material UANISO_HGO (defined in step 2) listed here.
Save the input file and close it.

steps.title: Create Initial Job
steps.instruction: Initialize the simulation job in Abaqus to generate the necessary input file.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'Job' module and click 'Create Job'.
Give the job a name (e.g., MyJob), select 'Continue', and click 'OK'.
In the 'Job Manager' dialog box, select the job and click 'Write Input' to create the .inp file in the Work Directory.

steps.title: Define Material Properties
steps.instruction: Set up the material definition in the Abaqus Property module.

substeps.instruction: Go to the 'Property' module and click 'Create Material'.
In the 'Edit Material' dialog box, enter 'UANISO_HGO' as the material name.
Select General --> User Material and click 'OK'.
Assign the material to the desired sections of the model.

steps.title: Configure Material Parameters in Input File
steps.instruction: Manually edit the input file to specify the structure-based material constitutive model parameters.

substeps.instruction: Open the input file (.inp) using a text editor (e.g., Notepad).

Below the material name, enter the following line, replacing the parameter names with pre-determined values for C_10, k1_l, k2_l, k1_s, and k2_s: '*Anisotropic Hyperelastic, user, formulation=INVARIANT, type=INCOMPRESSIBLE, local direction=3, properties=8 C_10, 0., k1_s., k2_s, 0., k1_l, k2_l, 0.'

steps.title: Set Up Final Job with Subroutine
steps.instruction: Create a new job that references the modified input file and the user subroutine.

substeps.instruction: Return to the 'Job' module and create a new job.
Under 'Source', select 'Input file', browse to the modified input file, and click 'Continue'.
In the 'Edit Job' dialog box, go to the 'General' tab.
Under 'User subroutine file', browse to and select 'uanisohyper_inv_colon.for'.
Complete any other necessary specifications and click 'OK'.

steps.title: Run Simulation
steps.instruction: Execute the simulation from the Job Manager.

substeps.instruction: Select the job from the 'Job Manager' dialog box and click 'Submit'.
